claims.head: Forecheck against patience
claims.body: The Hurricanes hound the puck, but the Bruins sit back. Carolina is one of the league’s best for forecheck pressure, and Boston is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Expect the Hurricanes to win more pucks back deep in the Bruins’ end.

notes.text: Michael Eyssimont has not played this season. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Connor Clifton has been a scratch for the last 7 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Will Borgen has taken his spot beside Nikita Zadorov.
Mark Jankowski is day to day (lower body injury) and has missed the last 4 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Taylor Hall is day to day (upper body injury) and has missed the last 6 games. Nikolaj Ehlers has taken his spot beside Logan Stankoven and Jackson Blake.
Bradly Nadeau was added to the roster on Oct 15 and has played beside Logan Stankoven and Jackson Blake.
Felix Unger Sörum was added to the roster on Oct 17 and has played beside Jordan Martinook and Nikolaj Ehlers.
Skyler Brind'Amour was added to the roster on Oct 23 and has played beside Nicolas Deslauriers and Eric Robinson.
Seth Jarvis was added to the roster on Oct 23 and has played beside Jordan Martinook and Jesperi Kotkaniemi.
Logan Stankoven has started killing penalties: on the ice for 32% of the team’s shorthanded time in 13 games, up from 1% last season.

BOS.head: A steep climb for the Bruins
BOS.body: Carolina has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Bruins’ best hope is getting good looks, plus a big night in goal.

story.head: Two of the best
paras: The Hurricanes are 9-2-2. The Bruins have won two in a row. Two of the league’s best teams meet.
The Bruins make their shots count, and the Hurricanes allow dangerous ones. The Canes hound the puck, but the Bruins sit back.

items.text: The Bruins have been without Connor Clifton since Oct 10, and have had to make do without Michael Eyssimont all season.
The Hurricanes have been without Mark Jankowski and Taylor Hall for several games.
Morgan Geekie has six goals in eight games against Carolina since 2023-24.
The Bruins’ record (.792) is well ahead of what their chances are worth (.588), largely thanks to their goaltending.
